भट्टाचार्यशिरोमणि or शिरोमणि alone, a title of the
logician Raghunātha.

शिरोमणि a title of the logician Raghunātha, is often
used by negligent writers for his principal work
the Tattvacintāmaṇidīdhiti or parts of it. Kāṭm. 4.
